source_name: Google Analytics Help – [GA4] What's new in Google Analytics (release notes 2026)
quote_verbatim: August 11, 2026 – Updated conversion window configuration; August 10, 2026 – Campaign data import validation report; July 30, 2026 – New diagnostic in Google Analytics for aggregate parameter issues; July 28, 2026 – Campaign data import currency update; July 13, 2026 – AdMob linking within Google Analytics; June 11, 2026 – New Source Group field with update to Source Platform values for improved source analysis; June 11, 2026 – Hostname filter; June 8, 2026 – New Google Business Profile integration; May 13, 2026 – New AI Assistant traffic measurement; May 7, 2026 – Data Manager API support for Google Analytics server-to-server events; May 4, 2026 – Conversion support in the Data API; April 29, 2026 – Configure your Google Analytics settings using Task Assistant; February 10, 2026 – Generated insights on the Home page; February 10, 2026 – Cross-channel budgeting (Beta); January 16, 2026 – Improved web conversion management and reporting capabilities for Google Ads customers (Beta); January 16, 2026 – Conversion attribution analysis report (Beta)

Z toho minimalne 5 primo zasahuje do sberu a interpretace dat (konverzni okno, hostname filtr, Source Group / Source Platform, AI Assistant kanal, povinna mena u importu nakladu).

source_name: Google Analytics Help – [GA4] What's new archive (2019-2025), sekce 2024
quote_verbatim: November 13, 2024 – Require config for custom events; October 22, 2024 – BigQuery export supports additional traffic source fields; October 11, 2024 – New Tag Diagnostics; October 28, 2024 – Direct attribution improvements; September 25, 2024 – Improved user-provided data session attribution; September 18, 2024 – Corrected Campaign Manager 360 attribution; September 3, 2024 – Corrected Display & Video 360 attribution; August 23, 2024 – Improved session_start event firing; July 19, 2024 – Session traffic source information now available in the GA4 BigQuery Export; July 17, 2024 – Additional UTM fields added to the BigQuery Event export for advanced channel analysis; July 16, 2024 – GA4 BigQuery Event Ordering additions for Web properties; June 27, 2024 – Introducing Tag Diagnostics; June 26, 2024 – Improved attribution data; June 10, 2024 – Updates to attribution models in GA4; June 3, 2024 – Require config for automatically collected events; May 22, 2024 – Improvements to attribution channel assignments; March 27, 2024 – Conversions and key events; February 28, 2024 – Primary Channel Group; February 9, 2024 – Event parameter limit increase; February 8, 2024 – Manual traffic source dimensions and report
summary_cs: Oficialni archiv release notes GA4 za rok 2024: celkem 55 datovanych zaznamu. Z toho 6 zmen atribuce (10.6., 26.6., 3.9., 18.9., 25.9., 28.10.), 3 zmeny schematu BigQuery exportu (16.7., 17.7., 19.7., 22.10.), zmena terminologie konverze -> klicove udalosti (27.3.2024) a dva pozadavky na 'config' u eventu (3.6. a 13.11.2024).

summary_cs: Meta vydava Graph/Marketing API 3x rocne (leden, kveten, rijen; od 2026 unor a cervenec) a kazdou verzi po ~2 letech vypina. Pro mereni to znamena: integrace Conversions API postavena na konkretni verzi prestane po sunsetu fungovat. Nejblizsi tvrde terminy: v19.0 sunset 21.5.2026 (jiz probehl), v20.0 sunset 24.9.2026 (za 3 tydny od data pristupu), Marketing API v24.0 sunset 6.10.2026.
notes: Primarni zdroj Meta. Dulezite pro argument 'termin, ktery klient sam nesleduje': v20.0 konci 24.9.2026.

source_name: Google Analytics Help – [GA4] BigQuery Export schema
quote_verbatim: batch_event_index: A number indicating the sequential order of each event within a batch. is_active_user: Whether the user was active (True) or inactive (False) at any point in the calendar day. session_traffic_source_last_click: last-click attributed session traffic source data across Google Ads, manual campaigns, SA360, DV360, and CM360 contexts. collected_traffic_source: UTM parameters and click identifiers collected with events. publisher record (early access only). Daily tables receive updates for up to three days after the dates of the events.
summary_cs: Schema GA4 BigQuery exportu se za 2024-2026 rozsirilo o pole batch_event_index/batch_ordering_id/batch_page_id (16.7.2024), collected_traffic_source UTM pole (17.7.2024), session_traffic_source_last_click (19.7.2024), dalsi traffic source pole (22.10.2024) a publisher record. Kazde rozsireni schematu znamena, ze existujici SQL transformace a Dataform/dbt modely mohou zacit vracet jina cisla nebo je treba je prepsat (aktivita E3).
notes: Primarni zdroj Google. Dokument sam nema changelog s daty; data zmen schematu jsou z release notes GA4 (EG12-003).

source_name: Google Ads API – Deprecation and sunset schedule (sunset-dates)
quote_verbatim: v22 release October 15, 2025 – sunset October 2026 (tentative); v23 release January 28, 2026 – sunset February 2027; v23.1 release February 25, 2026; v23.2 release March 25, 2026; v24 release April 22, 2026 – sunset May 2027; v24.1 release May 13, 2026; v24.2 release June 24, 2026; v25 release July 22, 2026 – sunset August 2027; v25.1 release August 2026; v25.2 release September 2026; v26 release October 2026 – sunset November 2027; v26.1 November 2026 (an optional release due to overlap with the holiday season)
summary_cs: Oficialni harmonogram Google Ads API: 9 planovanych vydani v roce 2026 (v23, 23.1, 23.2, v24, 24.1, 24.2, v25, 25.1, 25.2) plus v26 a v26.1 do konce roku. Kazda major verze ma sunset po ~13 mesicich. Kazdy nastroj, ktery importuje konverze nebo cte data z Ads (konektory, sGTM sablony, vlastni skripty), musi na tento rytmus reagovat.
notes: Primarni zdroj Google, nacteno pres r.jina.ai (primy fetch vraci jen navigaci). Prepisuje odhad E7-128 (5 vydani za 8 mesicu) na presnych 9 planovanych vydani 2026.

source_name: Google Ads API release notes – v25 breaking changes
quote_verbatim: v25 (2026-07-22): Legacy lifecycle goal resources removed. Migrate to unified goals schema using Goal.new_customer_acquisition_goal_settings. v24 (2026-04-22): Required fields added to DemandGenVideoResponsiveAdInfo (videos, logo_images); Campaign-level video brand safety removed; Removed LOYALTY_SIGN_UPS user category; New Lead Gen conversion action types (GA4/Firebase). v24.2 (2026-06-24): Local Services Ads conversion types added (ConversionActionType.LOCAL_SERVICES_ADS). v25.1 (2026-08-19): Brand Lift and Conversion Lift measurement support; new loyalty membership segmentation for conversions.
summary_cs: Konkretni breaking changes Google Ads API 2026, ktere se dotykaji konverzi: v25 odstranila legacy lifecycle goal resources (nutna migrace), v24 pridala nove typy konverznich akci pro lead gen z GA4/Firebase a odstranila kategorii LOYALTY_SIGN_UPS, v24.2 pridala typy konverzi pro Local Services Ads.
notes: Primarni zdroj Google.

source_name: Shopify Help Center – Upgrade to checkout extensibility
quote_verbatim: August 26, 2026 was the deadline for stores on a non-Plus Shopify subscription plan to upgrade their existing Thank you and Order status pages. As of August 28, 2025, the additional scripts section in the Checkout settings is view-only.
summary_cs: Shopify: 28.8.2025 se sekce 'additional scripts' v nastaveni checkoutu stala jen pro cteni (tj. mistem, kam se historicky vkladaly mericí skripty, uz nelze editovat), 26.8.2026 byl termin pro non-Plus obchody upgradovat Thank you a Order status stranky. Kdo do terminu neupgradoval mericí kod na Customer Events / Web Pixels, prisel o mereni objednavek.
notes: Primarni zdroj Shopify. Potvrzuje a upresnuje E7-015/E7-025.

source_name: Shopify Developer Changelog – Script tags are deprecated and will stop running on March 1, 2027
quote_verbatim: August 24, 2026 – Script tags are deprecated and will stop running on March 1, 2027 (Admin GraphQL API). July 2, 2026 – Deprecating the useBuyerJourneyIntercept API on checkout UI extensions (Action Required). July 6, 2026 – Customer Account API Customer.lastIncompleteCheckout and Checkout types removed in 2026-10 (Breaking Changes).
summary_cs: Shopify oznamil 24.8.2026, ze ScriptTags (bezny zpusob, jak analyticke a mericí aplikace vkladaji skripty do obchodu) prestanou fungovat 1.3.2027. To je znamy budouci termin, ktery rozbije mereni vsem obchodum, ktere do te doby nemigruji na Web Pixels / theme app extensions.
notes: Primarni zdroj Shopify (changelog). Konkretni URL zaznamu se nepodarilo nacist (404), citace je z prehledove stranky changelogu.

source_name: Privacy Sandbox blog – Next steps for Privacy Sandbox and tracking protections
quote_verbatim: [Google] will not be rolling out a new standalone prompt for third-party cookies … users can continue to choose the best option for themselves in Chrome's Privacy and Security Settings.
summary_cs: 22.4.2025 Google oficialne otocil: treti-strane cookies v Chrome zustavaji, zadny novy prompt. Duvod: 'divergent perspectives on making changes that could impact the availability' techto cookies. Pro mereni to znamena, ze plany a migrace pripravovane 2023-2024 (Privacy Sandbox API, server-side jako nutnost) se staly bezpredmetnymi nebo se odsunuly - prostredi se meni obema smery, ne jen k prisnejsimu.
notes: Primarni zdroj Google. Autor Anthony Chavez, VP Privacy Sandbox. Potvrzuje E7-130.

source_name: WebKit – Tracking Prevention (prehled ITP funkci)
quote_verbatim: Full Third-Party Cookie Blocking … ITP by default blocks all third-party cookies. 7-Day Cap on All Script-Writeable Storage … ITP deletes all cookies created in JavaScript and all other script-writeable storage after 7 days of no user interaction. Detection of Cross-Site Tracking Via Link Decoration … caps the expiry of cookies created in JavaScript on the landing webpage to 24 hours.
summary_cs: WebKit/Safari ITP: vsechny treti-strane cookies blokovany, cookies vytvorene JavaScriptem (tedy i _ga) mazany po 7 dnech neaktivity, a pokud uzivatel prijde s 'ozdobenym' odkazem (link decoration, napr. gclid/fbclid), zivotnost JS cookie na prichozi strance je 24 hodin. To je strukturalni pricina rozpadu atribuce u iOS/Safari publika.
notes: Primarni zdroj WebKit. Stranka neuvadi data ani verze Safari - pro datovani je treba jiny zdroj.

source_name: Google Ad Manager Help – Google consent management requirements for serving ads in the EEA, the UK, and Switzerland
quote_verbatim: As of 16 January 2024, a certified CMP integrated with the TCF is required when serving personalized ads to users in the EEA and UK. As of 31 July 2024, a certified CMP integrated with the TCF is required when serving personalized ads to users in Switzerland. … we are granting an enforcement extension until July 2025 [for CTV inventory].
summary_cs: Tvrdy termin Googlu: od 16.1.2024 je certifikovana CMP integrovana s IAB TCF podminkou pro personalizovane reklamy v EHP a UK, od 31.7.2024 tez pro Svycarsko. Kdo mel na webu nekompliantni listu, prisel o personalizovane reklamy. Certifikace CMP se navic musi obnovovat minimalne kazdych 12 mesicu.
notes: Primarni zdroj Google. Doplnuje E7-131 o presna data a o Svycarsko.

source_name: Google Analytics Help – [GA4] Verify and update consent settings in Google Analytics
quote_verbatim: If you are using Analytics data with a Google service, such as Google Ads, Play, Display & Video 360 or others, and you take no action, only end users outside the EEA will be included in audiences used by your linked advertising products starting early March, 2024.
summary_cs: Doslovna formulace Googlu k terminu brezen 2024: kdo neposila consent signaly (ad_user_data / ad_personalization), tomu od zacatku brezna 2024 vypadnou vsichni uzivatele z EHP z publik pouzitych v navazanych reklamnich produktech. Je to presne ten typ zmeny, ktera se v uctu projevi jako tichy propad, protoze zadny alert od Googlu neprijde.
notes: Primarni zdroj Google. Klicova citace pro argument 'termin, ktery klient nesleduje'.

source_name: Google Tag Manager Help – Announcements (release notes)
quote_verbatim: August 20, 2026 – Updates to Google tag and Google Tag Manager. July 9, 2026 – Updates to container behavior for unsupported installation paths. Announcement: Google tag and Tag Manager – deployment of Google tag within Tag Manager to replace GA4 Configuration tag. Updates to consent mode for traffic in European Economic Area (EEA).
summary_cs: Oznameni GTM: 9.7.2026 Google zmenil chovani kontejneru nactenych 'nepodporovanou cestou' (tj. kontejnery vlozene mimo standardni snippet - typicky pres proxy, custom loader nebo nektera CMS rozsireni), 20.8.2026 sjednoceni Google tagu a GTM vcetne zmen rozhrani. Drivejsi oznameni: nahrazeni GA4 Configuration tagu Google tagem.
notes: Primarni zdroj Google. Stranka neuvadi data u starsich oznameni - dostupna jsou jen data 2026.

source_name: Privacy Sandbox blog – Update on Plans for Privacy Sandbox Technologies (17.10.2025)
quote_verbatim: [Retiring] Attribution Reporting API (Chrome and Android), IP Protection, On-Device Personalization, Private Aggregation (including Shared Storage), Protected Audience (Chrome and Android), Protected App Signals, Related Website Sets, SelectURL, SDK Runtime and Topics (Chrome and Android). … We will follow Chrome and Android processes for phasing out these technologies and share updates on our developer site.
summary_cs: 17.10.2025 Google oznamil ruseni 10 technologii Privacy Sandbox vcetne Attribution Reporting API, Protected Audience a Topics. Kdo v letech 2023-2025 investoval do migrace mereni a remarketingu na tyto API, prisel o navratnost. Ukazka toho, ze prostredi se nemeni jen 'k prisnejsimu' - meni se i zpet, a i to je prace navic.
notes: Primarni zdroj Google. Presne datum oznameni 17.10.2025.

source_name: Google Blog (Chrome) – Testing Privacy Sandbox: Tracking Protection (14.12.2023)
quote_verbatim: Chrome is restricting website access to third-party cookies for 1% of users, part of our work to limit cross-site tracking on the web. … a key milestone in our Privacy Sandbox initiative to phase out third-party cookies for everyone in the second half of 2024, subject to addressing any remaining competition concerns from the UK's Competition and Markets Authority.
summary_cs: 14.12.2023 Chrome oznamil, ze od 4.1.2024 omezi treti-strane cookies 1 % uzivatelu a ze do 2. pololeti 2024 je vypne vsem. Tento plan se nikdy nenaplnil (viz EG12-011, otoceni 22.4.2025). Mezitim ale cely trh presouval mereni na server-side a pripravoval migrace - to je dolozeny priklad 'zmeny prostredi', ktera stoji praci, i kdyz nakonec nenastane.
notes: Primarni zdroj Google. Datum prispevku 14.12.2023, ucinnost 4.1.2024.

source_name: Privacy Sandbox blog – A new path for Privacy Sandbox on the web (22.7.2024)
quote_verbatim: Instead of deprecating third-party cookies, we would introduce a new experience in Chrome that lets people make an informed choice that applies across their web browsing, and they'd be able to adjust that choice at any time.
summary_cs: 22.7.2024 Google poprve otocil plan na vypnuti treti-strane cookies (misto vypnuti 'informovana volba uzivatele'). Druhe otoceni prislo 22.4.2025 (EG12-011), kdy Google zrusil i tuto novou volbu. Za 16 mesicu tedy tri ruzne oficialni plany - firmy, ktere mereni pripravovaly podle prvniho z nich, delaly praci nadarmo.
notes: Primarni zdroj Google, autor Anthony Chavez.

source_name: WebKit Blog – WebKit Features in Safari 17.0 (18.9.2023)
quote_verbatim: blocking for known tracking query parameters in links … mitigating trackers that map subdomains to third-party IP addresses … noise to fingerprintable web APIs … trackers that use third-party CNAME cloaking … Private Click Measurement for direct response advertising
summary_cs: Safari 17.0 (18.9.2023) zavedl blokovani znamych sledovacich parametru v odkazech (Link Tracking Protection - odstrani napr. gclid/fbclid), potlaceni CNAME cloakingu (tj. i prvni-strane subdomeny pouzivane pro obchazeni ITP) a sum do fingerprintovacich API. Prakticky dopad na mereni: cast prokliku z reklamy dorazi bez click ID a spadne do direct/organic.
notes: Primarni zdroj Apple/WebKit, nacteno pres r.jina.ai.

source_name: WebKit Blog – WebKit Features in Safari 18.4 (31.3.2025)
quote_verbatim: Partitioned cookies allow third-party content on a web page to create and access cookies on that specific site without allowing cross-site tracking. … Set-Cookie: TestCookie=12345; SameSite=None; Secure; Partitioned … Cross-site tracking domains cannot use partitioned cookies.
summary_cs: Safari 18.4 (31.3.2025) pridal podporu CHIPS (partitioned cookies). Pro mereni: reseni, ktera pouzivaji treti-strane cookies v iframe (napr. nektere CMP, chatboti, platebni brany, cross-domain mereni), musi cookies explicitne oznacit atributem Partitioned, jinak v Safari prestanou fungovat. Domeny klasifikovane jako trackery partitioned cookies pouzit nesmi vubec.
notes: Primarni zdroj Apple/WebKit, nacteno pres r.jina.ai.

source_name: Mozilla – Firefox 128.0 release notes (9.7.2024)
quote_verbatim: Firefox now supports the experimental Privacy Preserving Attribution API, which provides an alternative to user tracking for ad attribution. This experiment is only enabled via origin trial and can be disabled in the new Website Advertising Preferences section in the Privacy and Security settings.
summary_cs: Firefox 128 (9.7.2024) zavedl Privacy Preserving Attribution jako alternativu k sledovani uzivatelu pro atribuci reklamy. Dalsi prohlizecovy standard, ktery musi nekdo sledovat a rozhodnout, jestli se do nej investuje - Firefox je v CZ mensinovy, ale rozhodnuti 'nedelat nic' je take rozhodnuti, ktere nekdo musi udelat vedome.
notes: Primarni zdroj Mozilla (po presmerovani z mozilla.org na firefox.com).

source_name: Meta for Developers – Graph API v24.0 changelog (custom conversions)
quote_verbatim: Custom conversions: Updating custom conversions that are flagged custom conversions will fail. [v24.0+, and] will extend to all versions on January 6, 2026. Affected endpoint: POST /{custom-conversion-id}
summary_cs: Meta v24.0 (8.10.2025) zakazala aktualizaci oznacenych custom konverzi a od 6.1.2026 toto omezeni plati pro vsechny verze API. Kdo mel automatizovanou spravu custom konverzi (skript, konektor, agenturni nastroj), tomu od 6.1.2026 prestala fungovat bez ohledu na to, jakou verzi API pouziva.
notes: Primarni zdroj Meta. Priklad zmeny, ktera plati 'napric vsemi verzemi' - pripnuti na starou verzi API nepomuze.

source_name: Shoptet Blog – Novinky v integrovaném měření do Google Analytics 4 (30.11.2023)
quote_verbatim: [Shoptet v odpovedi v komentarich] dočasně pozastavili [nasazeni] … z důvodu několika nahlášených problémů s měřením … zjišťujeme příčiny
summary_cs: Shoptet 30.11.2023 oznamil rozsireni integrovaneho GA4 mereni (vylouceni navstev administratora pres datovy filtr, rozliseni B2B/B2C pres transaction_type a vlastni eventy purchase_b2c/purchase_b2b, view_item_list, funnel view_cart/begin_checkout/checkout_progress/purchase, generate_lead z newsletteru, nove parametry u add_shipping_info a add_payment_info). Cast nasazeni pak po hlasenich problemu s merenim docasne pozastavil bez uvedeni noveho terminu. Kazda z techto zmen vyzaduje zasah na strane e-shopu (aktivace filtru, zalozeni vlastnich dimenzi) - kdo ho neudela, mereni ma ale mysli, ze je hotovo.
notes: Primarni zdroj Shoptet. Potvrzuje E7-133 a pridava seznam konkretnich zmen. Shoptet nema verejny datovany changelog mereni - toto je blogovy prispevek.

source_name: Nápověda Sklik – Seznam Event Measurement (SEM)
quote_verbatim: moderní systém měření událostí na vašem webu … nahrazuje dosavadní retargetingové kódy a měřicí skripty konverzí
summary_cs: Seznam v roce 2026 zavadi Seznam Event Measurement (SEM): jediny skript sul.js nahrazuje dosavadni oddelene retargetingove a konverzni kody Skliku i Seznam Nakupy, pridava server-to-server mereni. Je to nejvetsi zmena mereni Skliku za posledni roky a dotyka se kazdeho ceskeho e-shopu, ktery inzeruje na Seznamu. Napoveda sama neuvadi zadny termin migrace ani osud starych kodu - klient tedy nema odkud zjistit, do kdy musi zasahnout.
notes: Primarni zdroj Seznam. Chybejici terminy v oficialni napovede jsou samy o sobe zjistenim: sledovani teto zmeny nelze delegovat na dokumentaci.

source_name: Google Analytics Help – archiv release notes: Improved conversion data completeness (6.8.2025)
quote_verbatim: We've improved conversion data quality to prevent under-reporting of conversions for Google Analytics customers whose properties have 2 or more linked Google Ads accounts.
summary_cs: 6.8.2025 Google zmenil zpusob, jakym GA4 pocita konverze u properties s dvema a vice napojenymi ucty Google Ads. Cisla konverzi se zmenila bez zasahu klienta - kdo srovnava mesic proti mesici nebo YoY, uvidi skok, ktery nema pricinu v jeho kampanich. Presne typ zmeny, kterou klient nepozna a spatne si ji vylozi.
notes: Primarni zdroj Google, doslovny text release note.

source_name: Google Analytics Help – archiv release notes: User-provided data attribution improvement (5.11.2025)
quote_verbatim: UPD now focuses on activation and Ads Conversions, improving Enhanced Conversions and Customer Match Audiences. [UPD no longer serves as a reporting identity identifier for sessions and users.]
summary_cs: 5.11.2025 Google zmenil roli user-provided data v GA4: prestala byt identitou pro reporting sessions a uzivatelu a slouzi jen pro aktivaci a Ads konverze. Kdo mel nasazene UPD kvuli cross-device reportingu, tomu se zmenila cisla uzivatelu a sessions ze dne na den.
notes: Primarni zdroj Google, doslovny text release note.

source_name: Google Analytics Help – archiv release notes: Require config for custom events (13.11.2024)
quote_verbatim: For most properties, you must have a config command or the Google tag installed on a web page for custom events to be sent.
summary_cs: 13.11.2024 Google zpristnil pozadavek: vlastni eventy se odeslou jen tehdy, kdyz je na strance config prikaz nebo Google tag. Kdo mel eventy posilane samostatne (napr. jen gtag('event') bez configu, nebo GTM tag bez Google tagu na dane strance), prestal je merit. Stejny pozadavek byl 3.6.2024 zaveden pro automaticky sbirane eventy.
notes: Primarni zdroj Google, doslovny text release note. Toto je ucebnicovy priklad tiche zmeny: nic nehlasi chybu, eventy proste prestanou chodit.

source_name: Google Analytics Help – archiv release notes: Updates to attribution models in GA4 (10.6.2024)
quote_verbatim: Currently, conversions that should be attributed to paid search are sometimes incorrectly attributed to organic search. [The fix adjusts attribution logic to capture campaign information more accurately on first events.]
summary_cs: 10.6.2024 Google opravil chybu, kdy se konverze patrici placenemu vyhledavani pripisovaly organickemu. Dopad: podil Paid Search vs. Organic Search se v reportech skokove zmenil bez zmeny kampani. Behem roku 2024 slo o jednu ze sesti zmen atribuce (10.6., 26.6., 3.9. DV360, 18.9. CM360, 25.9. UPD session attribution, 28.10. direct attribution improvements).
notes: Primarni zdroj Google, doslovny text release note.

source_name: Google Analytics Help – archiv release notes: Conversions and key events (27.3.2024)
quote_verbatim: A 'conversion' now refers to an important action that you want to use to measure the performance of your ad campaigns and optimize your bidding strategy.
summary_cs: 27.3.2024 Google prejmenoval konverze v GA4 na 'klicove udalosti' a slovo 'konverze' vyhradil pro Google Ads. Zmena terminologie napric celym rozhranim, reporty, API i skolenim klienta; cisla se nezmenila, ale kazda dokumentace, dashboard a interni definice KPI byla ze dne na den nekonzistentni.
notes: Primarni zdroj Google, doslovny text release note.

source_name: Google Analytics Help – archiv release notes: Cost data import is now Campaign data import (19.11.2025) a Cost data import required field updates (3.2.2025)
quote_verbatim: This change better aligns the feature's name with its primary function: importing campaign-level attributes and metrics. [All existing imports continue functioning without interruption under the new name.] … Cost data import required field updates (February 3, 2025) … Campaign data import currency update (July 28, 2026): Currency field now required when uploading cost data.
summary_cs: Import nakladu z ne-Googlovskych kampani se za 18 mesicu zmenil trikrat: 3.2.2025 zmena povinnych poli, 19.11.2025 prejmenovani na Campaign data import, 28.7.2026 povinne pole meny. Kazda zmena povinnych poli znamena, ze existujici automatizovany upload (skript, konektor) prestane fungovat, dokud ho nekdo neupravi.
notes: Primarni zdroj Google. Ukazka kumulace: jedna funkce, tri zmeny za 18 mesicu.

source_name: Google Analytics Help – archiv release notes: Improved ecommerce data availability and usability (25.8.2025)
quote_verbatim: Ecommerce dimensions (default and custom) are now available in Reporting secondary dimensions, filters, comparisons and customization.
summary_cs: 25.8.2025 Google zpristupnil item-scoped e-commerce dimenze v sekundarnich dimenzich, filtrech a srovnanich. Rozsireni moznosti, ale zaroven zmena chovani reportu: stejny report muze po zmene vracet jina cisla, pokud se v nem kombinuji item-scoped a event-scoped metriky.
notes: Primarni zdroj Google, doslovny text release note.

source_name: Google Analytics Help – release notes 2026: Updated conversion window configuration (11.8.2026)
quote_verbatim: Google Analytics conversions now support custom integer lookback windows for click-through conversions (CTC) and engaged-view conversions (EVC). [EVC 1-30 days, CTC 1-90 days, replacing previous fixed options.]
summary_cs: 11.8.2026 GA4 zmenil konfiguraci konverzniho okna z pevnych voleb na volitelne celociselne hodnoty (EVC 1-30 dni, CTC 1-90 dni). Zmena konverzniho okna primo meni pocty konverzi v reportech - kdo si ji neuvedomi, srovnava neporovnatelna obdobi.
notes: Primarni zdroj Google, doslovny text release note.

source_name: Google Analytics Help – release notes 2026: New diagnostic for aggregate parameter issues (30.7.2026)
quote_verbatim: Properties where aggregate identifiers (GBRAID and gad_) are missing from the URL will see a new diagnostic, including the problematic URLs and ways to resolve the issue.
summary_cs: 30.7.2026 GA4 zavedl diagnostiku chybejicich agregatnich identifikatoru (gbraid, gad_) v URL. Znamena to, ze chybejici click ID v URL je natolik casty problem, ze na nej Google udelal vlastni diagnostiku - typicky ho zpusobi redirect, CMP, nebo prepis URL na strane webu po releasu.
notes: Primarni zdroj Google, doslovny text release note. Prima vazba na what_broke=utm_chaos a release_web.

source_name: Google Analytics Help – release notes 2026: New Source Group field a Hostname filter (11.6.2026)
quote_verbatim: Source grouping is a new dimension concept that consolidates source values for common online platforms - Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok. … [Hostname filter] Allows customers to filter out (exclude) events based on their hostname.
summary_cs: 11.6.2026 GA4 pridal (a) Source Group, ktery slucuje hodnoty zdroje pro Facebook/Instagram/TikTok - tj. zmena, jak se stejna data zobrazuji v reportech; (b) hostname filtr, ktery umoznuje vyloucit eventy podle hostname (obrana proti cizim webum posilajicim data do property). Oboji vyzaduje rozhodnuti a nastaveni na strane spravce; bez nej se nic nezmeni, ale prilezitost k ocisteni dat propadne.
notes: Primarni zdroj Google, doslovny text release note.

source_name: Google Analytics Help – release notes 2026: New AI Assistant traffic measurement (13.5.2026)
quote_verbatim: You can now identify how users are discovering your site through chatbots like ChatGPT, Gemini, and Claude via a new AI Assistant channel. [Medium values receive 'ai-assistant' assignment automatically.]
summary_cs: 13.5.2026 GA4 zavedl novy kanal AI Assistant a automaticky priradil medium 'ai-assistant'. Dopad: cast navstevnosti, ktera se drive radila do Direct nebo Referral, se ze dne na den prestehovala do noveho kanalu. Kdo ma vlastni Channel Groups nebo dashboardy postavene na starem cleneni, ma od tohoto data nesouvisle rady.
notes: Primarni zdroj Google, doslovny text release note. Priklad zmeny, ktera zmeni historicke srovnani bez zasahu klienta.

source_name: Google Analytics Help – release notes 2026: Data Manager API support for server-to-server events (7.5.2026)
quote_verbatim: Data Manager API provides you with an alternative to Measurement Protocol (MP) for sending recommended and custom events directly to your Google Analytics property.
summary_cs: 7.5.2026 Google zavedl Data Manager API jako alternativu k Measurement Protocolu pro server-to-server eventy. Kdo posila konverze ze serveru (typicky e-shop s offline nebo backendovymi konverzemi), stoji pred rozhodnutim o migraci - a Measurement Protocol se timto stava kandidatem na budouci deprekaci.
notes: Primarni zdroj Google, doslovny text release note.

source_name: Google Ads Help – Updates to consent mode for traffic in the European Economic Area (EEA)
quote_verbatim: ad_user_data: Sets consent for sending user data to Google for advertising purposes. ad_personalization: Sets consent for personalized advertising.
summary_cs: Google pridal do consent mode dva nove parametry (ad_user_data, ad_personalization) - to je consent mode v2. Bez nich advertiser nemuze pouzivat personalizaci reklam, remarketing ani mereni pro uzivatele z EHP. Stranka sama neuvadi zadne datum vymahani; tvrde datum je jinde (EG12-013: 16.1.2024 certifikovana CMP, EG12-014: zacatek brezna 2024 vypadnuti EHP uzivatelu z publik).
notes: Primarni zdroj Google. Poznamka: oficialni stranka o consent mode v2 neobsahuje zadny termin - klient, ktery si ji precte, se datum nedozvi.

source_name: WooCommerce Developer Changelog – seznam vydani
summary_cs: WooCommerce vydal 10 verzi za 2,5 mesice (23.6.-3.9.2026), tj. cca 4 vydani mesicne, z toho dve major (11.0, 11.1) s povinnou aktualizaci databaze. Kazda aktualizace e-shopove platformy je udalost, po ktere je treba overit mereni (aktivita A1) - a u WooCommerce se deje ctyrikrat mesicne.
notes: Primarni zdroj Automattic/WooCommerce. Strankovani ukazuje 78 stran changelogu; nacetla se jen prvni.

source_name: WooCommerce Developer Changelog – 11.0.0 (4.8.2026) a 10.9.0 (23.6.2026)
quote_verbatim: WooCommerce 11.0.0 (August 4, 2026): Customers can claim previous guest checkout orders … Improvements to analytics accuracy and resilience … Database update required. WooCommerce 10.9.0 (June 23, 2026): Performance improvements for checkout and dashboard … Database update required. WooCommerce 10.9.4 (July 7, 2026): Fixed VAT exemption logic for block checkout.
summary_cs: WooCommerce 11.0.0 (4.8.2026) sam uvadi 'Improvements to analytics accuracy and resilience' a umoznuje zakaznikum prihlasit se ke starym guest objednavkam - obe zmeny meni chovani objednavkoveho toku a tim i mereni purchase. 10.9.0 (23.6.2026) meni checkout kvuli vykonu; 10.9.4 opravuje logiku DPH v block checkoutu (tj. meni se hodnota transakce).
notes: Primarni zdroj WooCommerce.

source_name: WebKit Blog – WebKit Features in Safari 26.0 (15.9.2025)
quote_verbatim: Safari 26.0 now prevents known fingerprinting scripts from reliably accessing web APIs that may reveal device characteristics … [blocks these scripts from] setting long-lived script-written storage like cookies or LocalStorage … [and from] reading navigational tracking state including query parameters and document.referrer.
summary_cs: Safari 26.0 (15.9.2025) zavedl pokrocilou ochranu proti fingerprintingu: skript klasifikovany jako fingerprintovaci nesmi zapisovat dlouhodobe cookies ani LocalStorage a nesmi cist query parametry URL a document.referrer. Prakticky dopad na mereni: pokud se mericí skript dostane na seznam, prijde o UTM parametry, gclid i referrer - tedy o atribuci - a jeho cookie ma kratkou zivotnost.
notes: Primarni zdroj Apple/WebKit, nacteno pres r.jina.ai. Nejzavaznejsi prohlizecova zmena pro mereni v obdobi 2024-2026.

source_name: Google Analytics Help – Updates to Google Analytics Data Controls
quote_verbatim: [Starting June 15, 2026] Google Analytics will transition to using Consent Mode (within Google Ads) as the single control for data. [The Google Signals setting will then] only control the association of your Google Analytics sourced data with signed in user information for behavioral reporting. … [Later in 2026] the Consent Mode ad_personalization setting will exclusively control if that data is used for personalization in your Ads account. … IP addresses that are automatically collected by the Google Tag and SDK will be encrypted and flow to your linked Google Ads account.
summary_cs: Tvrdy budouci termin: od 15.6.2026 prestava prepinac Google Signals v GA4 ridit, zda se data pouzivaji pro reklamu - jedinym ovladacem se stava Consent Mode v Google Ads. Pozdeji v roce 2026 pak nastaveni ad_personalization prebira vyhradni kontrolu nad personalizaci a IP adresy sbirane Google tagem budou sifrovane predavany do napojeneho Ads uctu. Kdo mel compliance postavenou na vypnutem Google Signals, ma od 15.6.2026 jinou realitu, nez si mysli.
notes: Primarni zdroj Google. Potvrzuje a upresnuje E7-132 z 1. kola presnym datem a doslovnou formulaci.

source_name: Google Tag Manager Help – Release notes (kompletni seznam 2024-2026)
quote_verbatim: July 9, 2026; July 1, 2026; June 22, 2026; June 3, 2026; June 1, 2026; May 14, 2026; May 1, 2026; February 4, 2026; January 29, 2026; January 5, 2026; December 11, 2025; September 30, 2025; August 1, 2025; July 31, 2025; July 28, 2025; June 30, 2025; June 24, 2025; May 8, 2025; May 7, 2025; April 4, 2025; March 19, 2025; March 10, 2025; March 4, 2025; December 10, 2024; November 7, 2024; October 11, 2024; October 9, 2024; September 19, 2024; August 28, 2024; July 2, 2024; June 27, 2024
summary_cs: Oficialni release notes Google Tag Manageru obsahuji 31 datovanych zaznamu za obdobi 27.6.2024 - 9.7.2026 (plus oznameni 20.8.2026), tj. cca 1,2 zmeny mesicne jen v samotnem GTM. To je nad ramec zmen GA4 (EG12-001 az EG12-003).
notes: Primarni zdroj Google. GTM release notes nebyly v 1. kole vubec pouzity.

source_name: Google Tag Manager Help – Release notes: Updates to container behavior for unsupported installation paths (9.7.2026)
quote_verbatim: Containers loaded with a GTM-XXXX ID won't be restricted, while product-specific ID types like G-XXXX or AW-XXXX will only permit tags and variables provided by Google.
summary_cs: 9.7.2026 Google omezil kontejnery nactene pod produktovym ID (G-XXXX pro GA4, AW-XXXX pro Ads): takovy kontejner nadale povoli jen tagy a promenne od Googlu. Kdo mel v takovem kontejneru vlastni HTML tagy, sablony tretich stran (Sklik, Meta, Heureka, konzultacni sablony) nebo custom JS promenne, tomu prestaly fungovat - bez varovani a bez chyby v rozhrani.
notes: Primarni zdroj Google. Nejtvrdsi 'tiche' rozbiti mereni v obdobi - presne odpovida hypoteze H2.

source_name: Google Tag Manager Help – Release notes: Conversion Linker a local storage (7.11.2024), Google tag first (10.3.2025), consent override (28.8.2024)
quote_verbatim: November 7, 2024: Conversion Linker now stores ad click information in browser local storage plus first-party cookies. March 10, 2025: Containers with Google Ads and Floodlight tags will automatically load Google tag first starting April 10, 2025. August 28, 2024: New consent mode override setting allows default consent status adjustment to 'denied' for selected regions. July 2, 2024: Google Tag and Google Tag Manager discontinue Microsoft Internet Explorer support beginning July 15, 2024.
summary_cs: Ctyri zmeny GTM s primym dopadem na mereni konverzi: 7.11.2024 Conversion Linker zacal ukladat informace o prokliku i do local storage (zmena chovani atribuce a pravni analyzy consentu), 10.3.2025 oznameno, ze od 10.4.2025 se v kontejnerech s Ads/Floodlight tagy automaticky nacte Google tag jako prvni (meni poradi spousteni tagu), 28.8.2024 pribylo nastaveni pro regionalni default 'denied', 2.7.2024 konec podpory Internet Exploreru od 15.7.2024.
notes: Primarni zdroj Google.

source_name: Google Tag Manager Help – Release notes: server-side a Google tag gateway (2025-2026)
quote_verbatim: March 4, 2025: Google tag now employs service workers to transmit data to server-side Tag Manager when available. May 8, 2025: First-party mode rebranded as Google tag gateway for advertisers, now supporting client and server-side tags. June 30, 2025: Web container client now serves all scripts; Google Analytics client discontinues dependency serving support. July 28, 2025: Floodlight tags in server-side Tag Manager transmit unconsented requests server-to-server for accuracy. August 1, 2025: New readAnalyticsStorage sandbox API allows developers to read client and session IDs safely in custom templates. February 4, 2026: Google Ads will automatically collect broader website event data. Advertisers may notice additional network requests to Google domains when these events are transmitted. June 22, 2026: Server-side data is intelligently joined with parallel browser signals, such as cookies, when a GCLID is present.
summary_cs: Server-side vrstva GTM se za 16 mesicu zmenila sedmkrat: service workers (4.3.2025), prejmenovani first-party mode na Google tag gateway (8.5.2025), zmena obsluhy skriptu ve web containeru (30.6.2025), server-to-server odesilani nesouhlasenych Floodlight pozadavku (28.7.2025), nova sandbox API readAnalyticsStorage (1.8.2025), automaticky sber sirsich udalosti Google Ads (4.2.2026) a spojovani server-side dat s prohlizecovymi signaly pri pritomnosti GCLID (22.6.2026). Kdo provozuje sGTM, musi kazdou z techto zmen posoudit - nekterym z nich se meni prave pravni i technicke chovani mereni.
notes: Primarni zdroj Google. Zmena z 4.2.2026 (Google Ads sam sbira sirsi udalosti) ma primy dopad na pravni posouzeni a na duplicity konverzi.

source_name: Google Tag Manager Help – Updates to Google tag and Google Tag Manager (20.8.2026)
quote_verbatim: [Google tags are being upgraded to function as full Google Tag Manager containers] … no changes will be made automatically, and you can choose whether to adopt the new configuration.
summary_cs: 20.8.2026 Google oznamil sjednoceni Google tagu a GTM: Google tagy se povysuji na plnohodnotne GTM kontejnery, rozhrani GTM dostava novou strukturu (sekce Settings, sbaleny tab Advanced) a beta vizualni tagovani. Zmena neni automaticka, ale znamena prepracovani navyku, dokumentace a interniho onboardingu - a rozhodnuti, zda a kdy 'optimalizovat' kontejner.
notes: Primarni zdroj Google.

source_name: Google Analytics Help – [GA4] BigQuery Export limits
quote_verbatim: Standard GA4 properties have a BigQuery Export limit of 1 million events for Daily (batch) exports. … If your property consistently exceeds the export limit, the daily BigQuery export will be paused and previous days' exports will not be reprocessed.
summary_cs: Doslovne pravidlo Googlu: standardni GA4 property ma limit 1 milion udalosti pro denni davkovy export do BigQuery, a pri jeho trvalem prekroceni Google export POZASTAVI a predchozi dny uz nedopocita. Zpetne doplneni tedy neexistuje - kdo si vypadku vsimne az za tri tydny, ma v datech trvalou diru. To je presne mechanismus popsany ve vypovedich N7-037 a N7-042 z 1. kola.
notes: Primarni zdroj Google. Klicova citace pro tier s BigQuery (aktivita E1/G6) - ospravedlnuje denni kontrolu exportu.

source_name: Google Analytics Help – archiv release notes: zmeny schematu BigQuery exportu 2024
quote_verbatim: July 16, 2024 – GA4 BigQuery Event Ordering additions for Web properties; July 17, 2024 – Additional UTM fields added to the BigQuery Event export for advanced channel analysis; July 19, 2024 – Session traffic source information now available in the GA4 BigQuery Export; October 22, 2024 – BigQuery export supports additional traffic source fields
summary_cs: Schema GA4 BigQuery exportu se v roce 2024 zmenilo ctyrikrat behem tri mesicu (16., 17. a 19.7. a 22.10.2024): poradi udalosti v davce, dalsi UTM pole, session traffic source a dalsi traffic source pole. Kazde rozsireni schematu je udalost pro aktivitu E3 (udrzba transformaci): stavajici SQL a dbt/Dataform modely bud zacnou vracet jina cisla, nebo je treba je prepsat, aby nova pole vyuzily.
notes: Primarni zdroj Google.

source_name: European Commission – The Digital Markets Act (about-dma)
quote_verbatim: The designated gatekeepers will have a maximum of six months after the Commission decision to ensure compliance [with DMA obligations]. … 1 November 2022: the DMA entered into force. 2 May 2023: the DMA became applicable.
summary_cs: DMA vstoupil v platnost 1.11.2022, ucinnym se stal 2.5.2023 a oznaceni strazci brany meli maximalne 6 mesicu od rozhodnuti Komise na uvedeni do souladu. Prave tento mechanismus vedl k terminu Googlu pro consent mode v2 (brezen 2024, EG12-014) - legislativni datum se do mericiho stacku promitlo s odstupem a v podobe, kterou Komise nezverejnila: jako zmena chovani Google tagu.
notes: Primarni zdroj Evropska komise. Stranka neuvadi doslovne datum 6.3.2024 - presny termin compliance je odvozen z data oznaceni strazcu brany a nebyl na teto strance overen; proto zde uvedeno jen to, co stranka rika doslova.

source_name: PPC Land – Google blocks script bypass that hit GTM container restrictions
quote_verbatim: containers reached through these paths degraded automatically into a restricted state, regardless of what kind of container they actually were … [affected] teams running custom integrations, migration scripts, or legacy implementations loading GTM through non-standard paths … March 2025: German court ruled GTM cannot activate before user consent.
summary_cs: Oborovy rozbor zmeny GTM z 9.7.2026 s doslovnou formulaci Googlu: kontejnery nactene nepodporovanou cestou (/gtag/js, /gtag/destination) se AUTOMATICKY degradovaly do omezeneho stavu bez ohledu na to, jaky kontejner to ve skutecnosti byl - tj. GTM-XXXX kontejner prisel o vlastni HTML a JS tagy, aniz by kdokoli neco zmenil. Postizeni: tymy s vlastnimi integracemi, migracnimi skripty a starsimi implementacemi. Clanek zaroven pripomina brezen 2025, kdy nemecky soud rozhodl, ze GTM nesmi byt aktivovan pred souhlasem uzivatele.
notes: Sekundarni zdroj (oborove medium) citujici primarni release note Googlu. Nemecky rozsudek 3/2025 neni v tomto clanku dolozen odkazem - neoveren.

source_name: 120Feet – Google quietly fixes a GTM bug that was blocking some containers by accident (10.8.2026)
quote_verbatim: Container ID permissions were enforced by the loading path rather than the ID itself … legitimate GTM- containers loaded via non-standard paths were incorrectly restricted, and restricted G- or AW- containers could gain unrestricted functionality through unusual loading paths.
summary_cs: Nezavisly rozbor teze zmeny (publikovano 10.8.2026): pred opravou se opravneni kontejneru ridila cestou nacteni, ne jeho ID. Dopad byl obousmerny - legitimni GTM- kontejnery byly omezeny neopravnene, a naopak G-/AW- kontejnery, ktere firmy pouzivaly ke governance (zamku na jen Google tagy), sly obejit. Clanek neuvadi, kdy chyba vznikla ani jak dlouho trvala.
notes: Sekundarni zdroj. Dulezite: ani po oprave nikdo neuvadi, jak dlouho byl stav rozbity - typicky pripad tiche zmeny bez oznameni.

source_name: Seresa / WebFX / Digital Applied – rozbory kanalu AI Assistant v GA4 (kveten 2026)
quote_verbatim: GA4 did not retroactively reclassify historical data, so older traffic that was not classified as AI traffic will usually remain under Direct or Referral. … between 35-70% of AI referral sessions arrive without referrer information and land in Direct … Perplexity still lands in Referral, AI Overviews count as Organic Search.
summary_cs: Nezavisle rozbory kanalu AI Assistant (spusten 13.5.2026): Google historicka data zpetne nepreklasifikoval, takze v casove rade vznikne skok - stara navstevnost zustava v Direct/Referral, nova v AI Assistants. Zaroven kanal zdaleka nepokryva vse (Perplexity zustava Referral, AI Overviews jsou Organic Search, 35-70 % AI sessions prichazi bez referreru a spadne do Direct).
notes: Sekundarni zdroje (tri nezavisle rozbory se shoduji). Podil 35-70 % je odhad autoru, ne merene cislo Googlu.
